recipes.subject: cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/web/router.ex
recipes.quantity: site PATCH mutable fields = theme, doc_type ONLY (dataset/name/slug immutable post-create)

recipes.subject: internal/cli/cloud_site_cmd.go
recipes.quantity: bp cloud site delete verb EXISTS on origin/main (case delete/rm); no --slug flag; --template + --theme parsed on create

recipes.subject: guerrilla /v1/graph
recipes.quantity: dataset= param honored (bogus dataset -> 0 nodes); nodes carry per-node type; production = 1803 nodes, paper-paper edges = 4 of 987
recipes.rerun: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BARKPARK_TOKEN" 'https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/graph?dataset=production' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);ns=d["nodes"];es=d["edges"];t={n["id"]:n.get("type") for n in ns};print(len(ns),len(es),sum(1 for e in es if t.get(e["from_id"])=="paper" and t.get(e["to_id"])=="paper"))'

recipes.subject: api/lib/barkpark/search/intelligence.ex
recipes.quantity: suggestion chips keyed (surface='documents', scope=dataset string, workspace_id) — production pool is dev exhaust live
recipes.rerun: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BARKPARK_TOKEN" 'https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/data/search/production/suggestions?limit=10' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;r=json.load(sys.stdin)["result"];print([p["query"] for p in r["popular"]])'

recipes.subject: cloud/lib/barkpark_cloud/registry.ex
recipes.quantity: content webhook is DATASET-scoped (/v1/webhooks/<dataset>) and minted only for kind=static — curated dataset isolates auto-deploy from production churn

recipes.subject: templates/search-starter
recipes.quantity: graph fetch passes ?dataset=<DATASET> from bare origin; detail route is dynamic /d/[type]/[slug] (SSR, multi-type capable)
